title: Identification and Patient Benefit Evaluation of Machine Learning Models for Predicting 90-Day Mortality After Endovascular Thrombectomy Based on Routinely Ready Clinical Information.
summary: Machine-learning models predicted 90-day mortality after endovascular thrombectomy and were compared with established scores in retrospective and external data. This is a prediction result, not evidence of improved outcomes.
